{{Top|canon="Tulip" style Imperial work station}}
{{Quote|Uhh, everything's under control. Situation normal.|Han Solo speaking into a comlink on a duty post|<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:JerjerrodTheDestroyer-ROTJHD.jpg|thumb|A duty post onboard the Death Star II]]
'''Command sector duty posts''' or just simply '''duty posts''' were circular posts designated to military personnel, and were notably used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Singular duty posts served as a "mini bridge" for the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]] in question.

==Characteristics==
The duty posts were surrounded by up to eight control boards. Specific functions included two duty monitor modules, two command interface modules, one computer access module, one communications module, one secondary computer access module, and one damage control module. On the duty monitor module were several instruments, including a security lockdown lever. The computer access module possessed several instruments, including two [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] buttons. The communications module contained several instruments, including process state indicators and a secure [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The command interface module contained several instruments including a command authority verifier. All of the modules had red blinking lights on the exterior edge of the module that acted as module status indicators.<ref name="Death Star Owner's Technical Manual">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref>

[[File:BattlefrontIICampaignDutyPost.png|left|thumb|A semi-circled duty post with a holoprojector in the center]]
The duty posts with eight control boards had partially extendable frames that slid aside to allow access to the assigned commanding officers. Within the post was a ventilated base.<ref name="Death Star Owner's Technical Manual" />

Some duty posts were wider, allowing space for multiple people, and lower to the ground. These models were also semi-circled, contained only five control boards,<ref name="TCW movie">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> and sometimes had a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] in the center.<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

==History==
===The Clone Wars===
[[File:RepublicMiliaryCourtroom-TWJ.png|right|thumb|The Coruscant Republic military base had two duty posts in its military tribunal chamber]]
Duty posts were located in several Republic military installations and ships, such as [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="Cloak of Darkness">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> and a [[Republic military base]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> Two were inside the ''Venator''{{'s}} brigs,<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" /> one was located inside the military base's detention block control room,<ref name="TJWKTM" /> and two were also inside of its tribunal courtroom.<ref name="TWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref> Additionally, two duty posts were located in a Republic-controlled sector of [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]] on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], one of which [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] used for cover during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].<ref name="TCW movie" /> One was also present on a Republic-controlled [[Ringo Vinda space station/Legends|space station]] above [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the Separatists captured the space station, and two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] manned the duty post until they were destroyed in the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]]<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

The Separatists also used duty posts, as well. Two were located inside the [[General's quarters]] on the ''[[Invisible Hand/Legends|Invisible Hand]]''.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> They were destroyed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] when the ship broke in half during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="Episode III novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

===Imperial era===
Duty posts were located on the [[Overbridge (Death Star I)/Legends|overbridge]] of the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], and were manned by [[Death Star Trooper/Legends|Death Star troopers]]. The station's [[Detention area|detention blocks]] also contained one; [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|AA-23]]'s was manned by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Shann Childsen/Legends|Shann Childsen]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> A duty post was also located in the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] [[Death Star command center|control room]], and contained the firing switch to the station's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]. This post was manned by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jad Bean/Legends|Jad Bean]] and [[Unidentified Death Star trooper|another Death Star trooper]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

[[File:The_Emperor_web_-_TCG.jpg|left|thumb|Duty posts in the Emperor's Throne Room on the second Death Star]]
The [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Emperor's throne room|throne room]] [[Emperor's Throne Room/Legends|on the second Death Star]] had two duty posts for his [[Emperor's Royal Guard|Royal Guards]] located on the raised platform where the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] throne sat.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Beneath the duty posts were additional consoles that, along with the duty posts, could override and operate the battlestation's functions.<ref name="Death Star Owner's Technical Manual">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref> A further third duty post sat under a large hologram of the galaxy in the eastern side of the room.<ref name="cutout">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> The [[Throne Room Complex (Wayland)|throne room]] in [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] also contained two duty posts.<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

The Rebel Alliance occasionally used duty posts as well, such as one located inside a [[Polis Massa Research Base|research base]] at [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] and two onboard the ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]]''.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

==Behind the scenes==
The idea of duty posts with eight control boards being able to slide one aside in order to let personnel enter was created by author [[Ryder Windham]] for the ''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''. Windham found it impractical for crewmen to be lowered in via hydraulics or access them through the floor.<ref name="Interview">{{WordPress|subdomain=roqoodepot|name=Roqoo Depot|url=interviews/death-star-owners-technical-manual-interview-with-ryder-windham|text="Death Star Owner's Technical Manual" Interview with Ryder Windham|archivedate=20230329162651}}</ref>
